title: Shein reports Q2 revenue up 0.9% YoY to $11B and net income down 66% to $228M, in its first report since a Hong Kong IPO; its stock is ~30% below its IPO price (Tracy Qu/Wall Street Journal)
summary: Tracy Qu / Wall Street Journal: Shein reports Q2 revenue up 0.9% YoY to $11B and net income down 66% to $228M, in its first report since a Hong Kong IPO; its stock is ~30% below its IPO price — The China-founded company expects the external environment to remain uncertain in the second half of 2026
